name: Pork Chop with Honey-Dijon Apples, Parsley Potatoes & Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ kg new potatoes
1 Granny Smith apple
½ small pkg grape tomatoes
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes, place in a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to the saucepan; cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 pork chops, boneless
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the chops are cooking, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Quarter and core apple, then slice into ¼-inch thick wedges; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.

When the chops are done, return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-low heat. Add onion, garlic, and apple; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion and apple are soft, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place vinegar, mayo, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp honey
⅛ tsp salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
When the onion and apple are soft, add broth, Dijon, and honey to the skillet; bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
118 ml (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Return the saucepan with potatoes to low heat; add butter, parsley, and salt. Cook, stirring frequently, until butter and parsley coat the potatoes, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add mixed greens to bowl with dressing and tomatoes; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops, apple sauté, potatoes, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
